Before & Afters Specials Memberships Shop Online Menu of Services Book Now Current Specials Book Online Home / Blog and News / Catherine Cole, RN Catherine Cole, RN Catherine Cole brings over 30 years of nursing experience and over a decade of experience as a master injector to CEC. Her extensive background in plastic surgery and medical aesthetics has shaped her specialization in facial balancing, comprehensive anti-aging treatments, and medical-grade skincare. She’s passionate about staying at the forefront of innovation, and is committed to ongoing education and training. Her practice integrates the latest technologies and techniques, ensuring each treatment plan is tailored to every patients goals and giving them a beautiful and natural result.
